svg.title: Load per Flink task for a 30,000 clicks a second ad, keyed by ad and salted 8 ways
svg.desc: Keyed by ad_id, task 1 carries 32,200 clicks a second (the hot ad plus its 2,200 share), above a rough per-task limit, while tasks 2 to 8 carry 2,200 each. Salted 8 ways, tasks 1 to 8 each carry 5,950: 3,750 of the hot ad plus 2,200.
